stories.title: Roles, profiles, Private sharing and the field-level security wall for every seat
stories.i_want: one role hierarchy and one profile per seat of both sides, Private default sharing, one writing profile per crossing field, and every identity field hidden from every profile that does not need it
stories.so_that: no second human gets a seat into an org where every field is open, no fact has two writers, and an identity value is never on the wire until it is revealed (D52, D54 point 8, B26)
acceptance: Given the role hierarchy, when read, then IR reports to IR Manager, KAM reports to Head of AM, Finance roles sit under Head of Finance, Digital Infrastructure sits above, and only the super admin is on the CEO role
Given Private default sharing on Leads and Contacts, when an IR-profile user lists Leads, then only their own and their subordinates' records return

Given the identity fields (pan, bank_account, Aadhaar_Number, UTRs), when the IR, IR Manager, KAM, viewer and Sahil's profiles are read, then each is hidden (Aadhaar hidden from every profile Zoho allows; only aadhaar_last4 and aadhaar_ref kept)
Given pan, when field permissions are read, then only Head of Finance and Compliance may read it; given bank_account, only Head of Finance and Finance may read it
Given any seat, when the investor record GET runs, then pan and bank_account are absent from the response and the reveal is a second GET ?fields=pan
Given Harsha opens Prakash Bhat, then PAN reads 'AFT•••••L' with reveal, Aadhaar '•••• •••• 5561' last four only and Bank '•••• •••• 1208' with reveal
Given a KAM, then PAN, Aadhaar and Bank read 'Finance only' and KYC reads 'clear'
Given notes or log text containing a PAN or account number, when shown to a non-Finance seat, then it is masked (safeNote)

Given the field register, then each field written by both sides (gate columns supp_verified_at, advance_confirmed_at, balance_confirmed_at, allotted_at, account_opened_at) has exactly one writer profile and every other profile is read-only or hidden

Given the restricted IR test user, when it tries to write a gate column, then Zoho refuses; given the restricted Finance test user writes one on an IR-owned Lead, then it succeeds under the sharing rule (B-12)
Given the IR profile, when its permissions are read, then 'Zoho CRM API Access' is on and Convert, Mass delete and Export are off

stories.title: Nothing leaks outside a seat's scope: seat x page x action x field matrix
stories.i_want: each person to reach only the records, pages and fields their seat allows, in the app and through its API, checked by a generated matrix on every build
stories.so_that: investor identity and money data never reaches someone who should not see it
acceptance: Given the seat capability table, when the matrix generator runs, then it writes one UI case per seat and page (menu shows / not) and one API case per seat and write action (allowed / refused)
Given a change to seat capabilities, when the build runs, then the matrix regenerates and the diff is shown for review
Given each seat on both sides, when signed in, then the rail lists exactly the pages in the matrix
Given Sahil (super user), when the matrix runs, then every page and action is allowed and PAN, Aadhaar and bank values are masked
Given an IR is signed in, when they open, search or deep-link a lead outside their book, then nothing opens and no field of that lead is returned by any route
Given a KAM, when Investors opens, then it lists exactly the Contacts they own
Given the restricted test user holds each role in turn, when every API route is called, then every record id returned is inside that role's scope
Given two seats read the same page, when the cache is inspected, then no entry is shared across scope keys
Given any page is rendered, when its text is inspected, then UTRs and account references appear only masked (last 4) until a logged reveal
Given the repository, build output and logs, when scanned, then no OAuth client secret, refresh token, admin token or identity value (PAN, Aadhaar, phone, email, UTR) is found
Given any Plane B/C log line, when read, then it holds record ids and status, never a name, PAN, bank account or note body
Given a person signs out, when the next person signs in on the same browser, then no draft, reveal, peek or queued save of the previous person remains
